name: Vera Huber
prior_offices: Weston County commissioner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Vera Huber is a Weston County commissioner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official commissioners page lists her on the board. The News Letter Journal reported that she finished third in the August 2026 Republican primary with 1,002 votes, one of three incumbents nominated.

sources.name: News Letter Journal, Weston County certifies 2026 primary results
